Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sanjay - 37 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Naira - 9 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan bursts out laughing.]

Sonali: "That's easy."

[Ishaan starts crying.]

Ishaan (softly): "That's great!"

[Ishaan smiles at Mother.]

Ishaan (laughing): "What next?"

[Ishaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Ishaan gets frightened and steps back.]

Ishaan (excited): "What next?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Sonali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Ishaan: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Sonali (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Ishaan does push-ups.]

Sanjay: "What a day to remember!"
